content:
Evan: Quick onboarding ask for Fjord-11B — can someone run a smoke + regression sweep and a short profiling pass today? Targets: p50 token-gen <= 120ms, p95 < 600ms for the 8-token smoke set. Please include KV-cache heatmap and kernel / allocator breakdown. I need raw perf logs + bench-bot upload.

Sara: On it, will run on canary GPU pool first (canary-rt-3). Which model URI exactly? also want the prompt set.

Evan: Model path: s3://redwood-models/fjord-11b/v1/ (sha256: 0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8i9j). Smoke prompts: s3://redwood-tests/smoke_prompts/fjord11b.txt. Quick run command to use as baseline:
```bash
bench-run --model s3://redwood-models/fjord-11b/v1/ --prompt-file smoke_prompts/fjord11b.txt --tokens 8 --profile --kv-cache --tiling adaptive --allocator jemalloc --batch-size 4
```
Add `--dry-run` if you want to validate config only. Tag results with `fjord11b-smoke-<run-id>`.

Matt: FYI cache defaults for canary-rt-3 are smaller than dedicated. If you see p95 spikes check KV cache eviction and tiling thresholds. Recommend adding `--kv-cache-buckets=4` for the first pass. Also include `perf top` sample for 30s.

Jia: I'll pick this up and run tonight. Quick question — should I also run `--quant int8` variant or keep native float32 first?

Evan: Start native float32 for baseline, then one quant run (int8 or int4) as follow-up. Put both results in the same bench-bot folder.

bench-bot: Uploaded baseline run (fjord11b-smoke-0001) to s3://redwood-bench-results/fjord11b/baseline-0001.tar.gz. Summary: p50=115ms, p90=210ms, p95=730ms, avg token cost 0.014 tokens/ms. Artifacts: perf, profiler flamegraphs, kv-heatmap.csv.

Jia: Initial quick-pass logs — baseline looks OK at p50 but we have a clear tail at token 8. snippet: 
```
[2026-03-18 21:12:03] token=6 latency=98ms
[2026-03-18 21:12:04] token=7 latency=112ms
[2026-03-18 21:12:05] token=8 latency=730ms  <-- kvcache eviction + kernel fallback
```
Noted elevated kernel switch to non-optimized matmul on that sample. Uploading flamegraph.

Matt: that log smells like intermittent kernel falling back due to sequence length or workspace allocation. Two quick experiments: 1) increase `--kv-cache-buckets` to avoid eviction, 2) force `--compiler-kernel=optimized` for that run and compare. Also try `--batch-size 1` to see single-request behavior.

Sara: Running two follow-ups now:
- run-0002: `--kv-cache-buckets=4 --batch-size 4 --tiling adaptive`
- run-0003: `--quant int8 --batch-size 1 --kv-cache-buckets=2`
Will push both to bench-bot when done. ETA ~30m.

bench-bot: Uploaded run-0002 -> s3://redwood-bench-results/fjord11b/run-0002.tar.gz (p50=118ms, p95=510ms). Artifacts: perf, kv-heatmap.

Sara: run-0002 improved p95 substantially. KV-heatmap shows much less eviction; tiling looks stable.

Matt: Nice. Can you also run a quick `--allocator tcmalloc` variant? jemalloc sometimes fragments for long-lived caches.

Sara: Yep will queue tcmalloc for run-0004.

bench-bot: Uploaded run-0003 quant-int8 -> s3://redwood-bench-results/fjord11b/run-0003-quant.tar.gz (p50=128ms, p95=450ms). Note quant artifacts include quant-stats.json.

Evan: Great — quantitative summary looks promising. Let's capture per-route breakdown in Console and attach the dashboard link in the PR. Can someone open a tiny ops PR to set recommended defaults for Fjord-11B (kv-cache-buckets=4, tiling=adaptive) and include a note to run tcmalloc if we see fragmentation?

Sara: I'll open PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-config/pull/482 (perf: Fjord-11B default runtime flags). PR has bench links and a short changelog.

Jia: Next steps from my side: re-run run-0002 with `--compiler-kernel=optimized` and attach kernel traces. Also will schedule a 30min hop to review flamegraphs tomorrow 10am PT.

Matt: If optimized kernel removes the tail we should push that to canary as default; otherwise we need to escalate to runtime team for allocator/memory layout changes.

Evan: Thanks all — good triage. If nothing else we have a clear action list: 1) merge PR for flags, 2) run optimized kernel trace, 3) decide quant path for production. I'll mark this thread resolved after PR merges. :thumbsup:
